title: [BUG] ROCm 7.0 compatibility issue with Attention2d modules
author: EmilienM

comments.author: rwightman
comments.body: @EmilienM thanks for the detailed explanation, understand the issue. But as you point out, non-contiguous tensors are common in vision arch and this is a vision arch, so shouldn't this be a ROCm bug? AFAIK anything operations that *requires* contiguous inputs and doesn't have the necessary handling themselvse is a bug no? There are some cases where you get a faster codepath if they are contigous but can't think of one where you'd expect or accept an error.. hrm.

comments.author: rwightman
comments.body:
@EmilienM I'll take a look tomorow, my main concern is that adding contiguous calls can negatively impact performance in situations where it isn't required, as it forces a mem copy for kernels that may not need it... I've definitely fiddled with that situation wrt to the LayerNorm impl and it could improve a few specific cases and make others worse.

Also, I don't have any AMD hardware/setups handy (asked them a long long time ago and they weren't very helpful, heh). So I'll just be checking perf regressions on CPU / CUDA

comments.author: rwightman
comments.body: Appears fixed on more recent ROCm versions so will close here
